```text
# #3038: Patch (part 1 of 11): Starship becomes a tag with Flying and Ranged, launches for (4), and the Drone Battleships stop being Starships
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Section 1, first three bullets, of #3000.

## What

**Starship is a tag.** Add `Starship` to the `Tag` string union (`crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs`, after `Faction`) and to its TypeScript copy (`apps/web/src/wire/catalog.ts`). The Dormant Starship (`stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship`) prints it on both faces. The launch (`starship::launch`, around line 425) stops granting the `Starship` keyword. `Keyword::Starship` / `KeywordKind::Starship` stay in the wire enum and the TS copy: the shipped catalog snapshots in `crates/cards/patches/*.json` print it on the Drone Battleships, and replays fold under them (R767000). No current card prints or gains it; say so in its doc comment and in the spec row.

**Every Starship has Flying and Ranged.** In `crates/engine/src/layers.rs`'s keyword layer, a card whose tags (read through the layers, as `query::tags_of` reads them) hold Starship has Flying and Ranged. `view_for` then lists them, and the board draws their marks with no client change (`MinionFace.tsx`'s `KeywordIcons`). The Dormant Starship's catalog entry also prints Flying and Ranged on both faces, its text leading `Flying, Ranged` as keyword lines do, so every view that reads the catalog shows them, as it does for any card with those keywords. Prove that no keyword pool newly reaches the Dormant Starship (R1857001).

**The hull stays as it is.** `StaticFlags.starship_hull`, `CardInstance.starship` and `dormant_starship_of` / `launched_starship_of` / `building_a_ship` don't change. Starship Pieces still fuse in, and every "your Starship" card still finds it (Ultra Capacitor, Starfleet Commander, Preemptive Strike, Call to Chaos (Scape Edition), Prepare For Liftoff, the Spacerace cards, Yamato Cannon, Sea Doctrine). Add an engine rules test that a Dormant and a launched Starship both carry the tag and are found. Whatever read the Starship *keyword* reads the tag instead:
- Scornboi (`c115_scornboi.rs`, `not_keywords: [StarshipPiece, Starship]`) spares the Starship tag, so it now exiles a Drone Battleship;
- After Burner's test filter (`c090_after_burner.rs`);
- `t_dormant_starship.rs`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/starship.rs` (line 609) and `crates/ai/tests/ai/starship.rs` (line 185).

`crates/ai/src` needs no change: the keyword was uncounted. `STARSHIP_NAMES` still draws by tag (`launch_names`): test that a Starship holding Human and Starship draws "Frontier's Promise" and one holding Starship alone draws an untagged name.

**The launch costs (4).** `STARSHIP_LAUNCH_COST` 3 → 4 (`crates/engine/src/config.rs`). The Dormant Starship's text becomes "Activate: Pay (4) to launch this.", and its `zh` changes with it. Update every text, ruling and comment that quotes the (3):
- the notes R1852003, R1852006, R1859013, R1881003, R2249000 and R2259000;
- `spec/06-keywords.md`'s Launch row;
- `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and `docs/radiant-audit.md`;
- the comments in `starship.rs` (line 347) and `t_dormant_starship.rs`.

Prepare For Liftoff's "costs (0)" stays.

**The Drone Battleships aren't Starships.** On `stinkyscape-t-shield-layer`, `-t-propagation-layer` and `-t-meltdown-layer`, the `Starship` keyword becomes `Flying` and `Ranged` on both faces (in their text and `zh` too). Everything else stays. They were never hulls. In each token's file, prove that it has Flying and Ranged and no Starship tag, can't be launched, and takes no piece: a dying piece summons a Dormant Starship instead.

## Files
- **Owned:**
  - engine: `crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs` (the `Tag` union), `crates/engine/src/starship.rs`, `crates/engine/src/layers.rs`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/starship.rs` (and its fixtures);
  - cards: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/t_dormant_starship.rs`, `t_shield_layer.rs`, `t_propagation_layer.rs`, `t_meltdown_layer.rs`, `c090_after_burner.rs`, `c115_scornboi.rs`;
  - AI: `crates/ai/tests/ai/starship.rs`;
  - web: `apps/web/src/wire/catalog.ts`, `apps/web/src/cards/glossary.ts` (the Starship term, now a tag), `apps/web/src/cards/starship.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/cards/art/stinkyscape.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/wire/generated/Tag.ts`;
  - the ruling notes named above.
- **By entry:**
  - the four tokens' entries in every shared file (and Scornboi's, if its words change);
  - in `config.rs`, the `STARSHIP_*` constants;
  - in `census.rs`, a new `Tag::Starship` arm;
  - in `spec/06-keywords.md`, the Starship, Launch and Exile aura rows. Leave the Starship Piece row alone: it sits between part 2's Dormant row and your Starship row;
  - in `spec/07-tokens.md`, the Dormant Starship and Drone Battleship rows.
- In `t_dormant_starship.rs`, make the Flak v3 sums (lines 392 and about 458) read Flak's stats from its definition instead of hard-coding (0, 4), (3, 5) and (6, 10), because part 3 halves Weapon Health.
- **Not yours:**
  - `layers.rs`'s `flashback_spent` read: leave it as it is (part 2 retires the field);
  - `MinionFace.tsx`, `CardFace.tsx`, `model.ts`, `art/CardArt.tsx`, `apps/web/src/test/fixtures.ts` and `keywordVisuals.*` (parts 8 and 9). The Starship keyword kind keeps its visual;
  - `script.rs`, `subsystems/fuse.rs`, `state.rs`, `slumber.rs`, `play_steps.rs`, and the files of Prepare For Liftoff (c144) and Ultra Capacitor (c133).

## Check
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' starship`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscape`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai starship`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/cards/starship.test.tsx src/cards/art/stinkyscape.test.tsx`. The icon test renders a Dormant and a launched Starship's unit view and finds `[data-keyword="Flying"]` and `[data-keyword="Ranged"]`.
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy` on each touched crate.
- In your summary, say what the pull request's screenshot of a Dormant and a launched Starship on the board should show.

### Working in the fullsend tree
This part of #3000 lands on `bot/issue-3000` beside the other parts, with no pull request of its own. One reconcile run makes the branch green, so this part need not pass every check alone, but it tests its own code.
- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card change (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).
- **Rulings** take this sub-issue's own block: R(N×1000) up, for its number N (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). Each has a test named after it and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/N.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- **Shared by entry.** Other parts edit other entries of `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` (and the `chinese.json` that `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` writes from it), `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `crates/cards/src/census.rs`, `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/07-tokens.md`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and `BUILD.md`. Change only the entries, rows and constants named here.
- **Left to the reconcile:**
  - `KEPT_SCRIPTS` in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: when a card's script changes, not only its numbers, keep the old script in the card's own file as `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 says, and name it in your summary;
  - the pending patch fragment;
  - any test in another part's file that your change breaks: name it in your summary.
- Commit only the files under `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` that your own types regenerate.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-3000`, not `main` (fullsend).
```
